notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_6.md CB6-F and 10.3. Code: backend/astrolabe/research_lab/cb6_tail.py (seal_tail), backend/scripts/run_cb6.py tail-seal. DRAFT. Id q0121 as named in CREATIVE_BATCH_6.md section 5. Exit 75 while an h7 run is not terminal (committed *_SEAL.json or *_NOT_RUN.json in seals/). The queue allows 48 consecutive tempfails (about 24 h) and h7 may run until 2026-10-22, so the coordinator promotes this spec ONLY after both h7 records are committed; the exit-75 wait is a safety net, not the plan. Seal also recomputes sha256 of every fetched file against the fetch manifest file_sha256 (exit 2 on any mismatch or missing file). Refuses (exit 2) a run that is not tail_fetch_complete (not_run_deadline and disjointness_unverified runs are never sealed). h7 key lookup by market id at 2 rps (parse guard: ids and keys only). Drops are recorded as DROPPED_KEY / DROPPED_H7 blocks in split.csv.gz (sealed files are never edited). Records the read location (host or Mac). AMENDMENT A-T1 (2026-10-17): this spec now passes --topup-run h8_tail_b. q0120b complete -> UNION seal: both manifests complete with file_sha256 verified (exit 2 otherwise), equal T_fetch8, no market id in common, key re-check, h7 drops and the event-hash split over the union rows, split.csv.gz gains a run column, SEAL.json carries topup.files (h8_tail_b file table) and topup.union_listing_sha256 (also in the declaration), one trial line, one committed copy; h8_tail_b is not sealed on its own (no SEAL in its directory; verify-seal / read_tail_sealed re-verify its file table). q0120b ended non-complete -> it is DROPPED: the seal records topup.status dropped with the reason and h8_tail seals alone. q0120b states at seal time: complete -> UNION seal (above). Terminal but not complete (not_run_deadline, disk_budget, disjointness_unverified) -> dropped with that reason, h8_tail seals alone. Pending (manifest in progress, or not started) before T_seal 2026-10-22T00:00Z -> exit 75 (not now), also if --topup-run were omitted: h8_tail alone never silently drops a pending q0120b. At or after T_seal an unfinished q0120b is marked not_run_deadline, a never-started one is recorded never_started_by_T_seal, and the seal records topup.refusal_reason (no_run_left_fetch_refused_or_never_started when no manifest exists, else none) separately from the deadline reason. Keep --topup-run h8_tail_b as declared; do not edit it to empty or none. A complete h8_tail_b next to an alone seal is refused (exit 2). The seal declaration discloses that the h8_tail_b frame reflects Gamma state after T_fetch8 (status, edited end dates), limited by outcome censoring and the price cap. Do not seal before q0120b is terminal: the top-up needs an unsealed h8_tail.
